selection_reasoning: This creates a converging dependency DAG: two independent resource-gathering tasks (finding yellow wool and mining pink concrete) feed into a final decoration task. The player must first locate and collect yellow wool, and separately mine pink concrete blocks, then use both materials to decorate a wall. This tests exploration (finding yellow wool), block-breaking (mining pink concrete), and block placement (decorating). The tasks are observable, verifiable, and don't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just finding, mining, and placing blocks.

edges.reason: Decorating the wall requires yellow wool blocks obtained by finding and collecting them from the scene
Decorating the wall requires pink concrete blocks obtained by mining them from the scene

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' means locate/observe the yellow wool in the scene. The yellow wool cluster is centered around (-4.5, 0.5, 8) relative to spawn. The player must navigate near it (within 16 blocks) and face toward it (within 60 degrees). This models 'the player has found and can see the yellow wool.'

Uses inventory_has because mining pink concrete with a pickaxe drops the block as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player must break at least 1 pink concrete block and pick up the drop. This is the standard rule for mine tasks — the mined item ends up in inventory.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') to verify decoration blocks were placed on or near the stone brick wall. The wall is at x=10 spanning z=-4 to z=4 and y=0 to y=4. We check a generous box around the wall face (x=7 to x=13, y=-1 to y=6, z=-6 to z=6) for at least 1 pink_concrete block placed as decoration. A second rule checks for at least 1 yellow_wool block in the same area. Both materials must be used to decorate the wall, matching the dependency on both prior tasks.

scene_description: An open grass clearing with three key elements: yellow wool blocks placed to the front-left of spawn (at z=8), pink concrete blocks behind-left of spawn (at z=-6), and a large stone brick wall to the right (at x=10). The player has a diamond pickaxe to mine both the yellow wool and pink concrete, then must place them on the stone brick wall as decoration.
task_text: Find and collect the yellow wool blocks, mine the pink concrete blocks, then decorate the stone brick wall using both materials.
design_notes: Layout: Player spawns at center of 31x31 grass platform. Yellow wool (9 blocks in a 4x2 cluster + 1 extra = ~9 blocks) at front-left. Pink concrete (3x2 cluster + 1 extra = ~7 blocks) at back-left. Stone brick wall (9 wide x 5 tall = 45 blocks) at x=+10. Air fill clears all trees/foliage in the area. Diamond pickaxe enables mining both wool and concrete. Wall is flat and accessible for placing decorative blocks against it.
